job_summary: A Marriage and Family Therapist who assesses client needs, develops individualized treatment plans, helps clients address interpersonal and relationship problems, and uses the required skills of Attention to Detail, Arm-Hand Steadiness, Quality Control Analysis, Operation Monitoring, Judgment and Decision Making, Operation and Control, Active Learning, Mathematics, and Learning Strategies.

hard_gates.requirement: Experience as a Marriage and Family Therapist
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires at least 5 years of experience as a Marriage and Family Therapist.

hard_gates.requirement: Experience as an Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires at least 4 years of experience as an Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon.
The source job description explicitly requires at least 4 years of experience as a Ship Engineer.
The source job description explicitly requires at least 3 years of experience as a Psychologist.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to use judgment and decision making when addressing client needs and treatment decisions
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job explicitly requires Judgment and Decision Making, while O*NET identifies Judgment and Decision Making as a transferable skill and Making Decisions and Solving Problems as a relevant work activity.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to use active learning and learning strategies to understand and apply new therapy methods
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job explicitly requires Active Learning and Learning Strategies, and O*NET lists both as essential skills for Marriage and Family Therapists.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to assess client needs and develop individualized treatment plans
soft_criteria.why_relevant: O*NET specifically lists collecting information about clients, determining client needs, and developing and implementing individualized treatment plans as core tasks.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to maintain accurate client records and written evaluations
soft_criteria.why_relevant: O*NET identifies Documenting/Recording Information as a relevant work activity and lists maintaining client records and writing reports or evaluations as detailed work activities.

soft_profile.candidate_evidence: Demonstrates strong ability to use judgment and decision making when addressing client needs and treatment decisions.
Shows some ability to use active learning and learning strategies to understand and apply new therapy methods.
Has limited demonstrated experience assessing client needs and developing individualized treatment plans.
Has strong demonstrated ability to maintain client records and prepare written evaluations.
